summary: Backend engineer with ~4 years designing distributed systems and event-driven infrastructure with a strong platform engineering streak. Expertise in Go, Python, AWS, and scaling microservices to 500K+ users.

bullets.text: Orchestrated full EC2 to ECS Fargate migration, cutting infra management overhead by 40% and deployment time by 50%; established CI/CD standards, zero-downtime strategies, and auto-scaling policies.
Re-architected async processing with AWS SQS FIFO & Standard queues via Django, achieving near-zero message loss and reducing queue-related incidents by 50%.

Led end-to-end R&D for a distributed video scoring platform — benchmarked custom models against Google's UVQ on accuracy, latency, and CPU — productionizing via SQS-driven pipeline and increasing throughput 8×.
Implemented lossless re-encoding and preview compression for large UGC videos (≤500MB), reducing load times by 40% and accelerating moderation and brand approval SLAs.
Rebuilt KYC platform with pluggable verification vendors and extensible document abstractions; reduced vendor onboarding by 60%, document rollout time by 70%, and overall KYC throughput by 35%.

Architected a parallel AI transcription pipeline using Sarvam AI, benchmarking India-accent speech models on accuracy and inference latency; mentored a junior engineer through full production rollout.
Designed and maintained RESTful APIs using Python (Django & DRF) for video scoring and KYC workflows, evolving partner-facing APIs while maintaining backward compatibility.
Re-architected invoice reconciliation as a Kafka-driven concurrent Go microservice, maintaining <15% CPU under peak load and significantly improving reliability.
Scaled event-driven Node.js proof-of-concept into a production-grade distributed service supporting 500K+ Gmail-synced users across web and mobile with high availability.
Redesigned reporting pipeline using SQL, Elasticsearch, and Snowflake warehousing, reducing internal report generation time by 80%.
Designed and implemented AWS Lambda serverless functions to enable autoscaling and improve system efficiency.
Designed fine-grained RBAC for store-level users, enabling secure role-scoped access to operational data.
Integrated multiple logistics carrier APIs, expanding services to 180+ cities and facilitating 10,000+ daily hyperlocal shipments.
Built concurrent Go parsers to extract invoice data from major e-commerce platforms, improving data accuracy by 90% and expanding supported sources by 67%.
Implemented Estimated Delivery Date (EDD) widgets contributing to a 60% relative increase in checkout conversion rates.
Developed an operations dashboard with key performance metrics, increasing operational productivity by 70%; contributed to ShipCoins loyalty program.
Optimized SQL queries and indexing strategies using Elasticsearch and Snowflake; maintained server utilization below 15% under peak loads.
Developed custom Scheduled Reporting systems using RabbitMQ, generating 100+ reports per hour for tailored client insights.
Engineered a Wrapper API reducing user interaction steps by 75% for shipment scheduling workflows.
Contributed to zero-to-deployment lifecycle of high-impact projects with a focus on scaling, optimization, and production integration.

projects.name: StealthAssistant
projects.description: Offline-first agentic desktop assistant with dual context pipelines — OCR-based screen capture and Whisper speech transcription — routed to a locally-hosted LLM via Ollama. Built with Python/PyQt6 with OS-level screen-capture exclusion for privacy.
